last_summary: The clips show distinct stages of salad preparation. v2 shows the creation of the dressing (adding powders and liquids to a bowl and whisking). v4 shows the assembly of the salad base (adding vegetables, lettuce, and herbs to a bowl). v1 shows the addition of flatbread to the salad and the initial tossing. v3 shows the final mixing stage where the salad (containing lettuce, herbs, flatbread, and tomatoes) is being tossed thoroughly.
